frames.gloss: 一旦……（就）……：once 引导的从属从句表示条件达成后主句即成立
frames.pattern_notes: once 在此为从属连词（=as soon as / from the moment when），后接完整句子（常用完成被动 have been V-ed），逗号后接主句。与已有清单中 not until / unless / the minute 同族但未收录。误读点：学习者会把 once 按副词'一次'理解，找不到从句主语而读断。

examples.s: And once these have been allocated, little day-to-day control is exercised from the top, because this would seem like 'breaking the rules'.

However, once the initial 'debt' has been cleared - and it's been calculated that this will only take fifteen years - this underground house won't cost anything - environmentally I mean - because unlike ordinary houses, it is run in a way that is completely environmentally friendly.

frames.gloss: 只是因为……/只是……而已：为前面提到的情况给出解释或委婉的辩解
frames.pattern_notes: 固定开头 It's just that + 陈述句，无主句依赖，可独立成句作解释性应答。just that 不是关系词也不是指示词，而是强调连词 that 前加 just。误读点：学习者会把 just that 拆开按'仅仅是那个'直译，或找不到 it 的指代对象；实际 it 为虚指，整存整取。

examples.s: It's just that I'm having difficulty thinking how I can do that.
It's just that I don't seem to be able to discipline myself.

frames.gloss: 正如我说过的/如你所知，……：as 引导的评注性从句置于句首
frames.pattern_notes: as + 主语 + 言说/认知动词（say/know 等，常用现在完成时或一般时），后接逗号再接主句。as 表'正如'而非'因为/当……时'。误读点：学习者会把 as 读成'因为'或时间连词，导致主句逻辑读反；这是评注性插入语家族（regex 盲区提示中的评注性副词同族）。

examples.s: As I've said, it was a design for a sort of underground house, and it was built into the earth itself, with two storeys.
And, as you know, this is very damaging to the environment.
KIRA: Well, as I said before, the biggest problem for me was a lack of familiarity with the education system here.

frames.frame: [The/Another 评价性名词] is that [S V]
frames.gloss: （主要）问题/好处/缺点在于……：评价性名词作主语 + 表语 that 从句
frames.pattern_notes: The problem / The drawback / Another characteristic / The main problem 等 + is + that 引导的表语从句（that 有时省略，如 I01965）。区别于已有清单中'the 抽象名词 that S V 同位语从句'（如 the fact that...）：此处 that 从句在系动词后作表语。误读点：学习者会把 that 当指示代词或关系代词，在 'is that' 处读断；骨架固定，整存整取优势明显。

examples.s: Another characteristic is that communication usually takes the form of conversations rather than, say, formal meetings or written memos.
TUTOR: The drawback is that everyone in the group seems to share the same ideas ... they keep being repeated in all the dissertations.
TUTOR: They'll be a good source of reference but the problem is they are sometimes too general.
The main problem is that the lecturers expect you to be critical.

frames.frame: One of the [复数名词] of/about [X] is that [S V]
frames.gloss: ……的好处/有趣之处之一在于……：one of 短语作主语引出表语 that 从句
frames.pattern_notes: one of the + 复数评价名词 + of/about + 对象名词 + is that + 从句。与已有清单'one of the 最高级'（one of the most popular attractions，纯名词短语）不同：此框架谓语固定为 is that，用于评价性论述。误读点：主语长、谓语远，学习者容易在 of 和 that 两处读断，且把 that 误判为关系词。

examples.s: Now one of the benefits of this culture is that the organisation has the ability to act quickly, so it responds well to threat, or danger on the one hand, and opportunity on the other.
Now one of the major benefits of this culture is that it's flexible.
And one of the interesting things about this project is that the owners - both professionals but not architects - wanted to be closely involved, so they decided to manage the project themselves.

frames.gloss: 我要做的另一件事是……：thing 后接关系从句，is 后直接跟动词原形
frames.pattern_notes: 已有清单'What S V is B 假分裂'的新变体：不用 wh-词而用 the/another/first + thing + 省略 that 的关系从句构成名词性割裂句，系动词后接不带 to（或带 to）的动词原形，甚至接祈使句（I01969 'is don't just take...'）。误读点：学习者预期 is 后是名词，遇到 'is talk to' / 'is don't' 会读断，且关系从句的空位需回指 thing。

examples.s: The other thing I'd like to do is talk to our technicians and see whether we could somehow limit the access to email.
Another thing I always advise is don't just take your notes and forget about them.
So the first thing they did was to look for a site.

frames.gloss: ……，而/然而……（前后对比）：whereas 引导的句尾对比从句
frames.pattern_notes: 已有清单'句尾对比 while'的新变体：用 whereas 替代 while，前后两个完整分句对比。区别于 while 让步用法。误读点：学习者不熟 whereas 的对比功能，容易把从句当成时间状语，或读不出前褒后贬/前易后难的对照关系。

examples.s: CAROLINE: Well, I found computer modelling fascinating - I have no problem following what's being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.
PAUL: Maybe you found them different because you're a more mature student now, whereas when you were studying in your country you were younger and not so assertive.

frames.frame: [时间名词] when [S V]（when 关系从句）
frames.gloss: ……的那个星期/时候（他们不开放/有空）：when 作关系副词修饰前面的时间名词
frames.pattern_notes: day / week / times / the moment 等时间名词后接 when 引导的关系从句（关系副词，when 在从句中作状语而非疑问词或连词）。已有清单未收录。误读点：学习者把 when 一律当时间连词，于是寻找'主句'，结果发现前面已有主句而读乱；需识别 when 回指前面的时间名词。

examples.s: It gets very crowded on Sundays, so I suggest you visit it on a quieter day, later in the week, but not on Thursdays which is market day - you won't find anywhere to park and it's also the only day of the week when they're not open!
The lecturers must set aside certain times every week when they're available for students.

candidates.s: It must be twelve months since you did our course?
candidates.note: It must be [时长] since [S V]：'有……没……了吧'。骨架与误读判据均过，但本批仅此 1 例，数量不足。

candidates.s: The sports injury treatment service operates on a paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service.
candidates.note: as does/did [S]：so 替代倒装回指'……也一样'。骨架强、易误读，但仅 1 例。

candidates.s: We began to extend the railway track and lay it among more interesting landscape by planting trees, which in turn attracted more wildlife, and by making cuttings through the rock.
candidates.note: which in turn [V]：非限 which 从句内嵌 in turn '继而'。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: We've known fights to break out over who gets it!
candidates.note: have known [O] to [V]：know 的罕见致使用法（=偶尔见过……发生）。非常有价值，但仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Another characteristic is that communication usually takes the form of conversations rather than, say, formal meetings or written memos.
candidates.note: rather than, say, [NP]：插入语 say = for example（regex 盲区提示的 say 假设语气）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: These organisations usually have separate departments that specialise in things like finance, or sales, or maintenance, or whatever.
candidates.note: 列举收尾 or whatever（'之类的东西'）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: The price was relatively low, and they liked the idea of recycling the land, as it were.
candidates.note: as it were 插入语（'可以说'）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: As it was, the quarry was an ugly blot on the landscape, and it wasn't productive any longer, either.
candidates.note: As it was 句首（'实际上'），与 as it were 不同义。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: It's too far to walk from the flat really.
candidates.note: too [adj] to [V]：骨架经典，本批仅 1 例（清单收录了 enough to 但无 too...to）。

candidates.s: PAUL: It sounds as if it was a real challenge.
candidates.note: It sounds as if [S V]：'听起来好像……'。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: However, once the initial 'debt' has been cleared - and it's been calculated that this will only take fifteen years - this underground house won't cost anything - environmentally I mean - because unlike ordinary houses, it is run in a way that is completely environmentally friendly.
candidates.note: unlike [NP], 主句：'与……不同'句首对比（同族已有 as opposed to）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: So are you pleased now that you did it?
candidates.note: now that [S V]：'既然/如今……'（regex 盲区提示项）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: People expect you to have problems with the process of reading and writing but, in fact, it is more a question of altering your viewpoint towards academic study.
candidates.note: it is more a question of [N/V-ing]：'更是……的问题'。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Now, what is of interest to us about this project is the features which make the building energy-efficient.
candidates.note: What is of [抽象名词] to [S] is [B]：假分裂+be of 抽象名词的复合变体。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: And the kind of person who does well in this type of business culture is one who is happy to take risks, and for whom job security is a low priority.
candidates.note: for whom [S V]：介词前置的 whom 关系从句（已有清单有 for/during+which 前置的 which 变体）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: And one of the interesting things about this project is that the owners - both professionals but not architects - wanted to be closely involved, so they decided to manage the project themselves.
candidates.note: both [A] but not [B] 破折号同位插入：'虽是 A 却不是 B'。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Well firstly, because it's found in large organisations, its fixed costs, or overheads as they're known, are low in relation to its output, or what it produces.
candidates.note: 双重框架：[X], or [别名] as they're known（'即人们所说的……'）与 [X], or what [S V]（'或者说……'）。均仅 1 例。

candidates.s: It gets very crowded on Sundays, so I suggest you visit it on a quieter day, later in the week, but not on Thursdays which is market day - you won't find anywhere to park and it's also the only day of the week when they're not open!
candidates.note: I suggest [S V原形]：suggest 后接虚拟语气原形动词。误读判据强，但仅 1 例。

candidates.s: As well as that, wherever possible, recycled materials have been used.
candidates.note: wherever possible：省略型让步状语（= wherever it is possible）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: So, eco-housing like this is likely to become much more ...
candidates.note: be likely to [V]：清单有 tend to/seem to，无 likely to。仅 1 例（句被截断）。

candidates.s: Please make sure to put it back when you've used it.
candidates.note: make sure to [V]：已有'make sure that'的新变体（接不定式）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Well, I found computer modelling fascinating - I have no problem following what's being taught, whereas quite a few of my classmates find it difficult.
candidates.note: have no problem [V-ing]：已有'have trouble V-ing'的否定变体。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: We've just arrived at the holiday flat, but I can't get the hot water and heating to work.
candidates.note: get [O] to [V]：使役 get。清单只收录了 have/get O V-ed。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: In the upstairs cupboard, you'll find the water heater.
candidates.note: You'll find/see [NP] [位置]：指示实物位置的呈现句（另见 I02048、I02073 共 3 例）。误读判据拿不准：学习者多能按字面读懂，暂记候选。

candidates.s: There should be some more instructions on the side of the heater.
candidates.note: There should be [NP]：情态 there-be 表预期'应该有'（另见 I02065）。骨架薄，拿不准。

candidates.s: Then there's a little square indicator under the third knob that's a kind of alarm light.
candidates.note: a kind of [N]：模糊分类短语（另见 I02067）。短语级、非句级，骨架判据拿不准。

candidates.s: And then there's the system for dealing with the waste produced in the house.
candidates.note: And then there's [NP]：列举推进式呈现句（另见 I02059）。骨架薄，暂记候选。

candidates.s: What do you think of the idea of introducing some workbooks?
candidates.note: the idea of [V-ing]（另见 I01985 'liked the idea of recycling the land' 共 2 例）。骨架判据拿不准：更近搭配而非句级框架。

candidates.s: Now whether you're going to university to study business or some other subject, many of you will eventually end up working for a company of some kind.
candidates.note: Whether [A] or [B], 主句：句首让步 whether（'不管……还是……'）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: We'll discuss it further when we've managed to ...
candidates.note: when we've managed to ...：to 后承前省略（to 后不接动词）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: WOMAN: You might also be interested to know the Centre is running a pilot scheme of talks for patients.
candidates.note: You might be interested to know [that S V]：礼貌引入新信息的框架。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: MAN: Well, why don't I send you a brochure with full details, Ms ... ?
candidates.note: Why don't I/we [V]?：第一人称提议（区别于建议对方的 Why don't you）。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Actually, I enjoyed this very much - meeting new people all the time.
candidates.note: [主句] - [V-ing 同位解释]：破折号后动名词短语回指解释宾语 this。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: It soon became clear that we were onto a winner.
candidates.note: It became clear that [S V]：已有'It was found/seems likely that'外置家族的新变体。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: On the other hand, this culture is often very slow to recognise the need for change, and even slower to react.
candidates.note: On the other hand, 主句：句首连接副词（另见 I02091 共 2 例）。误读判据弱（过于常见），暂记候选。

candidates.s: This is dealt with organically - it's purified by being filtered through reed beds which have been planted for that purpose in the garden.
candidates.note: by being [V-ed]：已有'主句 by V-ing'的被动变体。仅 1 例。

candidates.s: Moving on now to Task Cultures - this type is found in organisations that are project- oriented.
candidates.note: Moving on (now) to [NP]：讲座/讲解推进语。语域强、但更像语篇惯例，骨架判据拿不准。

candidates.s: Oh, and another thing I forgot to mention when we last spoke ...
candidates.note: another thing [S V forgot to mention]：与框架'[The/Another] thing S V is V'同族但缺系表结构。仅 1 例。
